Before I lock that in I need a quick exec sign-off for the combined concession. Marissa / Priyom — can I get approval to offer Crestline the 30d extension + $10k credit under deal CRST-2026-0421?

- Suggested structure: 30-day trial extension (ends 2026-08-01) + $10k credit applied to usage in pilot window. Credit will be recorded as a one-time promotional credit; not counted toward committed minimums.
- Minimal impact on unit economics given expected 2–3x consumption uplift in committed term.

I’ve attached the SOW draft and a short pricing calc for transparency. If approved I’ll confirm terms to Asha and get the SOW updated for procurement.

Best,
